gloss: to compete against; to play against; to face (an opponent)

definitions.gloss: to compete against; to play against; to face (an opponent)
definitions.explanation: To engage in a match or battle against an opponent, whether in sports, games, or other competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}いチームと{対戦|たいせん}した。
examples.english: We played against a strong team.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{試合|しあい}では{誰|だれ}と{対戦|たいせん}しますか。
examples.english: Who will you face in the next match?

examples.japanese: {決勝戦|けっしょうせん}で{去年|きょねん}の{優勝|ゆうしょう}チームと{対戦|たいせん}することになった。
examples.english: We ended up facing last year's championship team in the final.

notes:
Used broadly for any competitive matchup — sports, board games, video games, card games, martial arts, etc. The noun form {対戦|たいせん} is also very common on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対戦|たいせん}{相手|あいて}: opponent
- {対戦|たいせん}{成績|せいせき}: head-to-head record
- オンライン{対戦|たいせん}: online match
- {対戦|たいせん}{表|ひょう}: match schedule; bracket
- {対戦|たいせん}カード: matchup card

USAGE:
The particle と marks the opponent: AがBと{対戦|たいせん}する (A plays against B). Also frequently used as a noun modifier: {対戦|たいせん}ゲーム (competitive game), {対戦|たいせん}{形式|けいしき} (versus format).
